scope: Primary-source metadata and concise research notes; no copyrighted article text redistributed

sources.authors: Henry J. Brown and Yury Grabovsky
sources.title: On feasibility of extrapolation of completely monotone functions
sources.inspection: Full HTML available; introduction, problem formulation, Theorem 2.1, and local-problem statements inspected. No reproduction of their full proof.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Positive exponential-mixture extrapolation already has sharp asymptotic theory. Their relative-L2 discrepancy exponent is (2/pi) arcsin(1/x0); this is not imported without a norm/class reduction. The present finite positiveRC pair and waveform transfer argument must not be sold as discovery of extrapolation instability.

sources.authors: Marco Casini, Andrea Garulli, Antonio Vicino
sources.title: On input design in l-infinity conditional set membership identification
sources.inspection: Author-hosted abstract/introduction and publisher theorem/conclusion snippets inspected.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Worst-case bounded-input identification and optimization of the radius of a feasible system set are prior art. The explicit pair's nonnegative impulse difference gives a closed form, not a new general minimax paradigm.

sources.authors: Jake D. Huang, Charlie Meisel, Neal P. Sullivan, Andriy Zakutayev, Ryan O'Hayre
sources.title: Rapid mapping of electrochemical processes in energy-conversion devices
sources.inspection: Primary publisher summary and introduction available in search output; direct DOI open returned a tool error. Full source implementation and experiments not reproduced.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Joint time/frequency measurement and accelerated electrochemical characterization are established incumbents. They are granted the full waveform/path interface in the conditional lower bound. No empirical superiority claim follows.

sources.title: Binary multi-frequency signal for accurate and rapid electrochemical impedance spectroscopy acquisition in lithium-ion batteries
sources.inspection: Publisher abstract inspected; experimental results not independently reproduced.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Binary broad-spectrum excitation is an actual competitor; all such scalar waveforms are included by the peak/slew proof. Stochastic averaging or a different voltage-error law changes the lower-bound premise.

sources.title: Reconstructing Stieltjes functions from their approximate values: a search for a needle in a haystack
sources.inspection: Primary source referenced in immutable source packet; no new full-proof audit this worker run.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Certified EIS/Stieltjes reconstruction and uncertainty are prior art. No advantage over this method is claimed.

sources.title: Model-free spectral reconstruction via Lagrange duality
sources.inspection: Primary arXiv abstract inspected this run; full method not executed.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Positive spectral linear-functional bounds via duality already exist. The retained result changes the acquisition interface, rather than claiming novelty for positivity LP.

sources.title: A Reactance Theorem
sources.inspection: Original publisher abstract inspected; no full-proof audit.
sources.load_bearing_boundary: Interlacing pole/zero lossless passive networks are classical. Any finite-EIS null-network construction based on them is a model-class gate, not a historical novelty claim.
